ValidationRule.description: Restrict the editing of select fields during select Statuses
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c) != 'Pending', OR( ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(or_Create_Opportunity_upon_Approval__c), AND( ISCHANGED(Mapped_Opportunity__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Mapped_Opportunity__c))) ), AND( ISCHANGED(or_Date_Approved__c), NOT(ISBLANK(or_Date_Approved__c)) ) ), $Profile.Name != "Tanium Partner Portal Admin", NOT($Permission.Deal_Registration_Manager), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sorry, but the Account, Create Opportunity Upon Approval, Mapped Opportunity, Date Approved and Date Rejected fields can't be edited while the status of the Deal is not Pending. Contact channelops@tanium.com for assistance.
